anchors.text: Design Review approves Deployment Package before Release Authorization.
Release Authorization writes the approval event to Control Ledger.
Bridge Lead coordinates the incident bridge and assigns an Investigation Owner.
Unacknowledged critical alerts escalate to Bridge Lead within 10 minutes.
Evidence Vault retains closed investigation records for five years before Secure Disposal.
Security Reviewer and System Owner must both approve a privileged access request.
The approval relationship must carry control ticket AC-771.
External Intake data must pass through Redaction Service before entering Trusted Analytics.
Canonical services are Event Router, Invoice Processor and Compliance Archive, owned by Integration Team, Revenue Team and Risk Team respectively.
Infrastructure Change is assigned to Operations Owner and Schema Change to Data Owner.
Both changes use the approval window Thu 13:00–15:00.
Request goes to Procurement Review. If Budget available? is Yes, Issue PO then Supplier Confirmation. If No, Finance Escalation then Reprioritize Request.
Technician captures readings. If Within tolerance? is Yes, Close work order. If No, Engineering Triage then Schedule follow-up.
When smoke verification fails, Release Decision rolls back to the last verified deployment.
Normal operation supports 650 events per second.
Surge operation supports 950 events per second.
Escalation Coordinator owns triage priority and hands the case to Customer Liaison.
Customer Liaison owns customer updates after the handoff.
